'''Rhee Naez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] member of the [[White Maw]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was present when every leader was slaughtered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />
